SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
FROM Customer;

SELECT DISTINCT FirstName, LastName
FROM Employee
WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'
ORDER BY LastName, FirstName;

SELECT SUM(Invoice.Total) AS TotalAmount
FROM Invoice;

SELECT DISTINCT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Track t
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name;

SELECT DISTINCT A.ArtistId, A.Name
FROM Album A
JOIN Artist A ON A.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
GROUP BY A.ArtistId, A.Name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity * InvoiceLine.UnitPrice) AS TotalSpent
FROM Customer c
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON c.CustomerId = il.CustomerId
JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT Country, Revenue
FROM (
    SELECT 
        BillingCountry,
        SUM(Invoice.Total) AS Revenue
    FROM Invoice
    JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
    JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
    JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
    JOIN Artist ON Artist.ArtistId = Employee.EmployeeId
    JOIN Customer ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId
    GROUP BY BillingCountry
    ORDER BY Revenue DESC, Country ASC
    LIMIT 5
) AS RevenueTable

SELECT YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS Year, SUM(Invoice.Total) AS TotalRevenue
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY YEAR(InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY Year;

SELECT DISTINCT Title

);

SELECT DISTINCT t.Name
FROM Track t

SELECT DISTINCT A.ArtistId, A.Name, AVG(T.Milliseconds) AS AvgDuration
FROM Track T
JOIN Artist A ON T.ArtistId = A.ArtistId
JOIN Genre G ON T.GenreId = G.GenreId
JOIN Playlist P ON T.PlaylistId = P.PlaylistId
JOIN MediaType M ON T.MediaTypeId = M.MediaTypeId
JOIN InvoiceLine IL ON T.TrackId = IL.InvoiceLineId
JOIN Invoice I ON IL.InvoiceId = I.InvoiceId
JOIN Customer C ON I.CustomerId = C.CustomerId
JOIN Employee E ON C.SupportRepId = E.EmployeeId
WHERE T.Milliseconds > 0
GROUP BY T.TrackId, T.ArtistId, T.GenreId, T.Milliseconds
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY AvgDuration DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM countries c

SELECT DISTINCT c.capital_city
FROM countries c
JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3
WHERE c.name = 'Japan';

SELECT country_stats.population
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE country_stats.year = 2023
AND country_stats.population > 10000000;

SELECT DISTINCT c.name, c.population
FROM countries c
JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3
WHERE cs.year = 2023

SELECT c.name, c.iso3, c.region, c.income_group, c.capital_city,
       COALESCE(CAST(c.gdp_per_capita_usd AS DOUBLE), 0) AS gdp_per_capita
FROM countries c
JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3
WHERE cs.year = 2023
GROUP BY c.iso3, c.name, c.region, c.income_group, c.capital_city
ORDER BY gdp_per_capita DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH income_group_stats AS (
    SELECT
        iso3,
        name,
        region,
        income_group,
        SUM(gdp_usd) AS total_gdp_usd,
        COUNT(*) AS num_countries
    FROM countries
    GROUP BY iso3, name, region, income_group
),
gdp_by_income AS (
    SELECT
        iso3,
        name,
        region,
        income_group,
        total_gdp_usd,
        COUNT(*) AS num_countries
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2023
    GROUP BY iso3, name, region, income_group
)
SELECT
    iso3,
    name,
    region,
    income_group,
    total_gdp_usd
FROM gdp_by_income
ORDER BY total_gdp_usd DESC;

WITH country_stats AS (
    SELECT
        iso3,
        year,
        population,
        gdp_usd,
        gdp_per_capita_usd,
        region,
        AVG(gdp_per_capita_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS avg_gdp_per_capita
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2023
),
region_avg AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        AVG(gdp_per_capita_usd) AS avg_gdp_per_capita
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2023
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    cs.iso3,
    cs.name,
    cs.year,
    cs.gdp_per_capita_usd,
    ca.avg_gdp_per_capita
FROM country_stats cs
JOIN region_avg ca ON cs.region = ca.region
WHERE cs.gdp_per_capita_usd > ca.avg_gdp_per_capita
ORDER BY cs.year;

WITH world_stats AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) AS total_countries,
        SUM(CAST(population AS DOUBLE)) AS total_population,
        SUM(CAST(gdp_per_capita_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS total_gdp_per_capita,
        SUM(CAST(life_expectancy_years AS DOUBLE)) AS total_life_expectancy
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2023
),
weighted_stats AS (
    SELECT
        total_countries,
        total_population,
        total_gdp_per_capita,
        total_life_expectancy,
        SUM(total_population * total_life_expectancy) AS weighted_life_expectancy
    FROM world_stats
),
weighted_avg AS (
    SELECT
        total_life_expectancy AS avg_life_expectancy
    FROM weighted_stats
)
SELECT
    avg_life_expectancy
FROM weighted_avg;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS smaller_countries

SELECT c.name, c.region, c.life_expectancy_years

WITH region_stats AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        SUM(population) AS total_population,
        SUM(gdp_per_capita_usd) AS total_gdp_per_capita,
        SUM(urban_population_pct) AS urban_pct,
        SUM(internet_users_pct) AS internet_pct,
        SUM(unemployment_pct) AS unemployment_pct
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2023
    GROUP BY region
),
combined_population AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        SUM(population) AS combined_population
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2023
    GROUP BY region
),
region_share AS (
    SELECT
        cp.region,
        (cp.combined_population * rs.total_gdp_per_capita) / (cp.combined_population * rs.total_gdp_per_capita + rs.total_population) AS share
    FROM combined_population cp
    JOIN region_stats rs ON cp.region = rs.region
)
SELECT
    region,
    ROUND(share * 100, 2) AS share
FROM region_share
ORDER BY region;

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM countries c
JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3
WHERE cs.year = 2023 AND cs.gdp_usd IS NULL;

WITH country_stats AS (
    SELECT
        iso3,
        year,
        population,
        gdp_usd,
        gdp_per_capita_usd,
        life_expectancy_years,
        fertility_rate,
        urban_population_pct,
        internet_users_pct,
        unemployment_pct,
        (gdp_usd - gdp_usy(year - 1)) / gdp_usy(year - 1) * 100 AS gdp_growth_pct
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE iso3 = 'FR'
),
gdp_growth AS (
    SELECT
        iso3,
        year,
        gdp_growth_pct
    FROM country_stats
)
SELECT
    iso3,
    year,
    ROUND(gdp_growth_pct, 2) AS gdp_growth_pct
FROM gdp_growth
ORDER BY year;

WITH income_group_stats AS (
    SELECT
        iso3,
        name,
        region,
        income_group,
        SUM(gdp_per_capita_usd) AS total_gdp_per_capita,
        COUNT(*) AS num_countries
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2023
    GROUP BY iso3, name, region, income_group
),
ranked_countries AS (
    SELECT
        iso3,
        name,
        region,
        income_group,
        total_gdp_per_capita,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY income_group ORDER BY total_gdp_per_capita DESC) AS rn
    FROM income_group_stats
)
SELECT
    iso3,
    name,
    region,
    income_group,
    total_gdp_per_capita
FROM ranked_countries
WHERE rn = 1;

)
SELECT
    region,
    median_urban_pct
FROM ranked_regions
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo';

SELECT MAX(body_mass_g) AS heaviest_body_mass
FROM penguins;

SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS average_flipper_length
FROM penguins;

SELECT AVG(p.bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill_length, AVG(p.sex) AS avg_sex
FROM penguins p
WHERE p.sex = 'male'
OR p.sex = 'female';

SELECT species, AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS avg_flipper_length
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species
ORDER BY avg_flipper_length DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM penguins
GROUP BY island
ORDER BY penguin_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT
        species,
        sex,
        AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass
    FROM penguins
    WHERE sex IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY species, sex
)
SELECT species, sex, ROUND(AVG(body_mass_g), 2) AS avg_body_mass
FROM stats
GROUP BY species, sex;

WITH penguins AS (
    SELECT
        species,
        AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_mass_male,
        AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_mass_female,
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM penguins
    GROUP BY species
),
mass_diff AS (
    SELECT
        species,
        avg_mass_male - avg_mass_female AS mass_gap
    FROM penguins
)
SELECT species
FROM mass_diff
WHERE mass_gap > 0
ORDER BY mass_gap DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM penguins
WHERE bill_length_mm > (
    SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm)
    FROM penguins
    WHERE species = 'Adelie'
);

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo' AND island = 'Biscoe') * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE island = 'Biscoe')
    ),
    'Gentoo' AS percentage
FROM penguins
WHERE island = 'Biscoe';

SELECT species, year, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species, year
ORDER BY species, year;

SELECT DISTINCT island
FROM penguins
GROUP BY island
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT species) > 1;

SELECT species, island, body_mass_g
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species, island
ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC;

SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass_2007, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass_2009
FROM penguins
WHERE year IN (2007, 2009)
GROUP BY species;

WITH overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) AS overall_avg
    FROM penguins
),
species_island_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.species,
        p.island,
        AVG(p.bill_length_mm) AS avg_flipper_length
    FROM penguins p
    GROUP BY p.species, p.island
)
SELECT
    species,
    island
FROM species_island_stats
WHERE avg_flipper_length > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg);

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        species,
        AVG(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill_length,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_bill_length DESC, species ASC) AS rank
    FROM penguins
)
SELECT
    rank,
    species,
    avg_bill_length
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank;

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT
        species,
        AVG(body_mass_g) AS mean_mass,
        STDDEV(body_mass_g) AS stddev_mass
    FROM penguins
    GROUP BY species
)
SELECT species, stddev_mass
FROM stats
ORDER BY species;
